errors.evidence: The Llama-LUFFY-Easy line ends at approximately 0.4 in the description, but the figure shows it ending closer to 0.38-0.39, which is within the reference's stated ~0.4. However, the description also states the Llama-On-Policy-Easy line ends at 0.35, which matches the reference, so the 0.4 claim for Llama-LUFFY-Easy is slightly exaggerated beyond the ±3% tolerance for the Easy Training Set y-axis (0.4 * 0.03 = 0.012, so acceptable range is 0.388-0.412). The figure shows ~0.38-0.39, which is below this range.

The Llama-LUFFY-Hard line ends at approximately 0.17 in the description, but the figure shows it ending closer to 0.2, which is the reference value. The y-axis range for the Hard Training Set is 0.0 to 0.2, so 0.17 is outside the ±3% tolerance (0.2 * 0.03 = 0.006, so acceptable range is 0.194-0.206).
